name: The Boneyard
description: Ossory's laying-up field on the dead moon below the station, where hulls wait to be cut
character: A flat of grey dust where the breakers set down the hulls they have no berth for yet: wrecks left where they landed, hull plates stood on edge, and a drainage cut under a spoil bank along the south side. Nothing grows and nothing stands higher than a wreck, so whoever is camped out there sees a ship come down from the far end of the field and has the whole walk across it to decide what to do.
